create.name: Cuong Lu
create.bio:
Cuong Lu is a Zen teacher born in Vietnam in 1968 who grew up in the Netherlands after his family emigrated there in 1980. He trained for sixteen years as a monk under Thich Nhat Hanh at Plum Village and received lamp transmission as a dharma teacher in 2000. After returning to lay life he spent six years as a Buddhist chaplain in the Dutch prison system, work he later described in his book The Buddha in Jail. He founded Mind Only, a Dutch school for the study and practice of Buddhist psychology, and more recently No Word Zen, which has a practice centre in the Limousin countryside of central France.

His teaching rests on the Yogacara, or consciousness-only, tradition and on Nagarjuna's Middle Way, which he puts in dialogue with Western philosophy. He has a gift for making demanding texts such as the Diamond Sutra feel immediate and usable. He leads multi-year study programmes, online modules and residential retreats in Dutch and English, and teaches in the United States, including at the Barre Center for Buddhist Studies and in IMS online programmes. Shambhala publishes his books Happiness Is Overrated and At Peace, Filled with Joy, a reading of fifty-seven verses from the Dhammapada.

books.title: At Peace, Filled with Joy: Buddhist Wisdom from the Dhammapada
books.author: Cuong Lu
books.description: A commentary on fifty-seven verses from the Dhammapada, with reflections and simple exercises for daily practice. Cuong Lu shows how ordinary difficulty can become a doorway to understanding, compassion and joy.

books.title: Happiness Is Overrated: Simple Lessons on Finding Meaning in Each Moment
books.author: Cuong Lu
books.description: Short Zen lessons that question the chase after happiness and point instead to meaning found in each ordinary moment. Written in a plain, conversational voice with stories from his life and teaching.

books.title: The Buddha in Jail: Restoring Lives, Finding Hope and Freedom
books.author: Cuong Lu
books.description: Stories from his years as a Buddhist chaplain in Dutch prisons, where he met inmates with the practice of looking deeply and seeing our shared humanity. A book about freedom of mind in the least free of places.

courses.title: IMS Book Club: At Peace, Filled with Joy
courses.description: A live online conversation with Cuong Lu about his Dhammapada book, followed by questions from participants. The session is recorded and stays available to registered participants for ninety days.

courses.title: De Diamant Soetra: Ontdek Je Ware Zelf
courses.description: An eight-evening online module on Zoom in which Cuong Lu translates and explains the Diamond Sutra line by line, with time for questions after each talk. Taught in Dutch.

courses.title: Masterclass 2027: Van oorsprong, niet één ding
courses.description: A residential masterclass at the No Word Zen practice centre in France on Huineng and the school of sudden awakening. Participants explore how attachment to existence, non-existence and consciousness keeps us bound, and what it means to let go of all three.
